notes: AEAT Manual practico de Renta 2022, Parte 1, Capitulo 15 (Calculo del impuesto: determinacion de las cuotas integras), 'Ejemplo practico: calculo de las cuotas integras estatal y autonomica' de don A.B.C., residente en la Comunidad Autonoma de Aragon. Givens quoted verbatim (L37745-L37748): base liquidable general 23.900, base liquidable del ahorro 2.800, minimo personal y familiar 5.550. The 2022 manual states the state and Aragon general scales both produce 2.667,75 at this base (L37753-L37765), both minimum-scale subtotals are 527,25 (L37767-L37771), both cuota integra general values are 2.140,50 (L37774-L37776), both ahorro gravamen values are 266, and both final cuota integra values are 2.406,50 (L37778-L37784). The 2022 registry keeps 0511 and 0512 as manual casillas, so the real-behavior scenario supplies both at 5.550,00 and neutral manual family components 0515-0518 at zero; it does not import the 2024 computed/profile chain.
